routingCpuLabel: whole-process CPU from ps during 12 sequential chats, not routing-only CPU
computationLabel: nearest-rank percentile of stored computation_ms wall-clock rank time
clientChatLabel: client-observed sequential chat time, including the mock provider
addedInferenceLatencyLabel: client wall time minus stored model_attempts.duration_ms for the same request
evidenceCacheHitRateLabel: cache_hit rows divided by stored routing_shadow_rankings for this tenant since the test clock mark
locksLabel: maximum ungranted pg_locks during 47 samples while 4 delayed chats overlapped
throughputLabel: 12 sequential chats divided by their wall time
activeStreamsLabel: model_attempts with stream_status connecting or streaming while one stream was held, then after release
